Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

vrtstack (development version)

Documentation

  • New vignette vignette("vrtstack") walking the three entry points (from-scratch stacking, recipe extension, catalog emitter), a pkgdown site with a grouped reference index, and a README section covering all three. The GDAL >= 3.11.3 requirement for the gdal_run()-backed paths is documented.

Bug fixes

  • gdal_mdim_stack() (and the vrt_*_stack() wrappers) now copy the source band’s scale, offset and unit type onto the data array. Packed bands such as GHRSST MUR analysed_sst (Int16, scale 0.001, offset 25) previously read back as raw counts through the VRT’s unscaled view.

  • The <SRS> dataAxisToSRSAxisMapping is now computed from the CRS’s WKT axis order instead of being fixed at "2,1". For a (stack, y, x) array with EPSG:4326 (latitude first) it is "2,3"; the old value mapped longitude onto the stack dimension, and a 2D slice of the array got an invalid mapping. emit_mdim_vrt(), which wrote no mapping (GDAL then assumes "1,2"), gets the same computed mapping.

  • Array children are written in the XSD’s order: the stack coordinate’s <Unit> before its values, and emit_mdim_vrt()’s Unit / NoDataValue / Offset / Scale.

New features

  • New catalog-to-VRT emitter surface, revived from earlier design work: a mdim_sources() table (one row per concat step, kind = "band" or "array") and a per-collection mdim_signature() (grid, SRS, dtype, array metadata) are fed to emit_mdim_vrt(), which writes a multidimensional VRT without opening a file – the grid comes from the signature (“identical grid or refuse”, no warping). stac_sufficiency() reports whether a parsed STAC item carries the metadata the emitter needs, and verify_vrt() round-trips an emitted VRT through gdal mdim info. Design notes in inst/design/mdim-vrt-catalog-scoping.md.

  • vrtstack() gains metadata_from ("first", "last", or an explicit source path) to choose which source donates the coordinate units and root-group provenance restored onto an auto-generated recipe (template = TRUE).

  • The concat dimension may be any axis, not only axis 0, and need not be named "time": mdim_template_extend() takes the axis position from DimensionRef order. A regularly-spaced concat coordinate is converted to explicit inline values when concat_values are supplied.

Bug fixes

  • mdim_template_extend() now gives a clear error when the concat dimension has no coordinate array of the same name, instead of an opaque xml node-type error, and validates inline-vs-regular coordinate values robustly.

Packaging

  • .Rbuildignore now excludes .github and local scratch directories.

vrtstack 0.2.0

Bug fixes

  • gdal_mdim_stack() no longer derives the data-array name from a bare common filename prefix, which could produce a numeric, invalid array name (e.g. 200206 from a shared date). The resolver now takes the variable token from the shared part of the names – the first identifier word of the common prefix or the last of the common suffix, whichever carries more letters (e.g. analysed_sst from GHRSST tiles, claytotal from soil layers) – never a leading-digit name, and falls back to band1. An explicit array_name still overrides. Band-description-based naming is left as a later option. (#1)

  • gdal_mdim_stack() now writes a <SourceSlab offset="0,0,0" count="1,nrow,ncol" step="1,1,1"/> in every source. Without the count, GDAL opens every source, in order, to learn its shape on each read through the VRT (a HEAD and a header GET per /vsicurl/ COG), so even a one-step read of a long remote stack touched every file. With it, a read opens only the sources it covers. Same finding as mdsumner/raad.virtualize#14; see also hypertidy/gdalxarray#39, which stops sparse selections being widened to a covering read. The template-extend path in vrtstack() already copied the count from its template. Tests added (tests/testthat/test-sourceslab.R).

New features

  • New graft_coord_units() and graft_group_attrs() restore metadata that gdal mdim mosaic drops from a recipe: coordinate-array units (CF units, which the netCDF driver lifts into the array Unit rather than an attribute) and invariant root-group provenance attributes (title, source, references). Both are idempotent and read the values from one source via gdal mdim info, or from a supplied units=/attrs= vector that needs no GDAL. They are wired into the template = TRUE path of vrtstack() via an internal mdim_recipe_xml(), and become no-ops once GDAL propagates the metadata itself.

  • New vrtstack() is a single entry point with two construction paths that share one concat-axis resolver:

    • from-scratch (template = NULL) - the existing GeoTIFF/COG behaviour, stacking 2D sources into a single new 3D array.
    • template-extend (template = <vrt> or template = TRUE) - fleshes out a small “first-n” multidimensional VRT to a full file set, re-parameterising only the concat dimension and the per-array <Source> lists. Coordinate arrays, slab geometry, and per-array scale/offset/unit/attributes are carried through verbatim from the template.

  • New mdim_template_extend() performs the recipe rewrite as a pure xml2 tree operation (no GDAL required). It handles sources that themselves carry several arrays (e.g. OISST anom/err/ice/sst): data arrays are detected structurally as any <Array> owning a <Source>, and each array’s SourceArray path and slab count/step are read from its first source rather than assumed from the array name. The concat axis position is taken from DimensionRef order, so it need not be axis 0.

  • New resolve_concat() turns a concat-axis spec (explicit vector, single-group regex over basenames, function of basename, or date-parsing inputs) into axis values, and is shared by both construction paths.

  • New mdim_mosaic_xml() builds the first-n recipe via gdal mdim mosaic through /vsimem/, so no template file need touch disk (requires gdalraster with the gdal_run algorithm interface).

Minor improvements and fixes

  • Filename extraction now uses stringr::str_match() instead of regmatches()/regexec(), which silently dropped non-matches and misaligned rows against files.

  • VRT construction and editing now go through xml2 rather than string assembly, removing the hand-rolled XML escaping.

  • mdim_template_extend() rejects Date/POSIXct concat_values with a clear message: coordinate values must already be in the array’s declared units (e.g. days-since-epoch). Encode them first via resolve_concat(origin=, unit=) or read them from the source files.

Packaging

  • Declared xml2, stringr, jsonlite and utils in Imports (they were used but undeclared, an R CMD check error).

  • Added continuous integration: a standard R-CMD-check matrix, and a canary job that checks against a development GDAL build (hypertidy gdal-r-python:dev), so changes in GDAL’s multidim surface are caught early.

vrtstack (0.1.0)

  • gdal_mdim_stack() and the convenience wrappers vrt_time_stack(), vrt_depth_stack(), and vrt_regular_stack() for stacking 2D rasters into a multidimensional VRT along a new dimension, with regular-axis detection, filename-based dimension values, and /vsicurl/ support.
